pr_title: [DTS] Only delete types of data that are being transferred
pr_body:
### What does it do?

Update the import and transfer commands to generate the correct restore object

TODO:

- [ ] add more tests
- [ ] ~~refactor restore logic so it's modular and independent from local-source~~ I'm skipping this one because it would be a big structural change that might break things*

* I think we first need a discussion about if it would make more sense to make local-source a wrapper for a local-restore-source rather than local-source using strategies, since the strategies are/will be so tightly integrated it may be difficult to abstract them
 
### Why is it needed?

The initial functionality of the restore strategy causing a global reset of Strapi data caused too many users to be confused. 

The updated functionality of only touching data included in a transfer matches user expectations to not touch files that are excluded in a transfer or import.

### How to test it?

Using exclude or only with transfer or import should now only delete the files that are included in the process.

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

Closes https://github.com/strapi/strapi/issues/17572

Completes DX-862, DX-863, DX-864

issue_context.title: Data export with --exclude files will still delete/backup files on import with the same flag, links lost
issue_context.body:
## Bug report

### Required System information

- Node.js version: 18
- NPM version: 8
- Strapi version: 4.12.1
- Database: SQLite
- Operating system: Linux Mint 21.2
- Is your project Javascript or Typescript: Javascript

### Describe the bug

When running the following commands:

- `yarn strapi export --no-compress --no-encrypt -f testExport --exclude files`
- `yarn strapi import -f testExport.tar --exclude files`

It won't copy the assets in but the file list still remains (file links are excluded) however during the import the files are still "moved" during the backup when they should be left in place

### Expected behavior

We may need to add another option to exclude which would just be `assets` to remove any export/import/transfer related to the assets themselves but keep the file and file links in place. This is what was requested by two customers as they don't need a backup of the files themselves but just the database entries related to them.

### Screenshots

N/A

### Code snippets

N/A

### Additional context

Related to two EE tickets:
- TID4484
- TID4490

Possibly related to (not duplicate of)
- https://github.com/strapi/strapi/issues/17571
- https://github.com/strapi/strapi/issues/17530

review_comments: Can't we make this `included` so that it's not double negated as `!notIncluded`? It could be confusing
we can also not upload to local IMO, it would be better to start disconnecting DTS from upload providers specific logic, and also it's more consistent

I don't think it's necessary to add this to all the transfers, because they all use the `this.#transferStage` and it already checks if the step should be skipped: 
```    
if (!source || !destination || this.shouldSkipStage(stage)) {
```

I think I did this to prevent it from being called even directly. I think it works for now. In the future, I can potentially see a use case for the transfer engine skipping it, but allowing it to be called manually, and we can update it then to allow in that case.
